message.jaymospowers.avatar.sign_1: The heat here feels like home. Too much like home.
message.jaymospowers.avatar.sign_2: The fire under your skin pushes back when you hold it.
message.jaymospowers.avatar.sign_3: You can't remember the last time you felt cold. You can't remember feeling anything but the fire.
message.jaymospowers.avatar.consumed_sub: The fire you held so long holds you now
message.jaymospowers.avatar.doused: The water takes the fire out of you. You are only Emberborn again.
commands.jaymospowers.avatar.progress: %s: %s of the way to the flame
